source_name: State Service of Ukraine for Food Safety and Consumer Protection (Держпродспоживслужба) — consumer-rights arm
why_relevant: General consumer-protection authority that still publishes explanatory material on financial-services consumer rights and receives consumer complaints; useful for mapping the jurisdictional boundary with the NBU and for catching cross-agency campaigns.

source_name: Держпродспоживслужба (State Service on Food Safety and Consumer Protection) — financial-services consumer pages
why_relevant: Frequently assumed to be the consumer-protection supervisor for banks, but its own publications state that supervision of banks' compliance with financial-services consumer-protection and financial advertising law sits with the NBU. Worth tracking mainly as a boundary/jurisdiction marker and for general consumer-law changes that spill into retail finance.

source_name: new.bank.gov.ua — NBU site rebuild / staging mirror
why_relevant: A parallel 'new' NBU web presence surfaced in search results with the same content paths. Worth tracking because a site migration would break every collector URL in this cell; it is an early warning of the future URL scheme, not a content source in its own right.

source_name: OTP Bank Ukraine — English site and social channels (Viber/Telegram/Facebook notice mirrors)
why_relevant: The bank explicitly directs customers to its Viber/Telegram/Facebook channels for tariff- and credit-rule change news; these mirrors sometimes carry notices earlier or in shorter form than the website, and the English site gives EN terminology for the same events.
Alternative commercial front-end over the court register with document search and case tracking; a redundancy option if reyestr throttles and Opendatabot licensing is unattractive.

Baker McKenzie Kyiv has historically issued named 'Legal Alerts' on Ukrainian payment-systems law and e-money; the global insight feed is where those surface. Coverage is episodic rather than periodic, so pair it with a syndication watch.

entity_name: Academic/legal-scholarship layer on Ukrainian financial-consumer protection
source_name: Academic/legal-scholarship layer on Ukrainian financial-consumer protection (tlaw.nlu.edu.ua, Karazin Journal of Legal Studies)
why_relevant: Peer-reviewed analyses of the legal basis for financial-consumer protection and of the still-unadopted financial ombudsman model — provides the institutional-gap context that explains why complaint volumes concentrate on the NBU and the courts.

source_name: cis-legislation.com — English translations of NBU board resolutions
why_relevant: Provides English renderings of core NBU acts (e.g. the Instruction on regulation of banks' activities, financial monitoring regulation, licensing of financial service providers) — useful for analyst comprehension where the NBU has published no official English version.

English-language Ukrainian outlet republishing Interfax-Ukraine economic dispatches; usable free English proxy for wire content and for how Ukrainian financial regulation is framed to foreign investors.

source_name: PRAVO.UA — юридичне видання про проєкти НБУ
why_relevant: Ukrainian legal-press outlet that reports NBU draft publications with the comment window explicitly stated (observed: draft Regulation on enforcement measures against non-bank market participants, comments to 1 Nov 2023). Historical archive helps reconstruct past consultation windows the NBU page no longer surfaces.

entity_name: Ukrainian Interbank Payment Systems Member Association "EMA"
source_name: Ukrainian Interbank Payment Systems Member Association "EMA" — LinkedIn
why_relevant: Confirms EMA's official English name and self-description (represents members before the NBU, Cabinet and Parliament on card programmes, card-business legal/technological issues and cashless payments) — useful for entity resolution and English-language alias mapping. Low collection value: small following, and LinkedIn scraping is restricted.
